top_signals.title: New Mexico jury awards $47M in tanker truck crash lawsuit
top_signals.summary:
A New Mexico jury awarded $47 million to a pick up truck driver and his mother following a 2022 tanker truck crash near Carlsbad.

The post New Mexico jury awards $47M in tanker truck crash lawsuit appeared first on FreightWaves.

top_signals.title: Strive scoops up another 1,223 bitcoin for $100 million as total holdings reach 36,818 BTC
top_signals.summary: Strive paid approximately $81,734 on average per bitcoin, adding to the 2,822 BTC it had acquired earlier last week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Indonesian exchange to exclude high-concentration stocks from key index
U.S. small-scale solar generation has quadrupled in the last decade
top_signals.summary: We estimate that U.S. generation from small-scale or rooftop solar photovoltaic systems (smaller than 1 megawatt of capacity) has increased from 18,812 gigawatthours (GWh) to 92,979 GWh over the last decade. The four states with the highest generation of small-scale solar in the country-California, Arizona, Texas, and Florida-are in regions with more abundant solar resources. Even though it is in a region with lower solar resources, New York ranks as the fifth-largest rooftop solar generation producer as a result of capacity growth supported by technology improvements and state incentives.

top_signals.title: ConnectWise suspends Cloud Backup service after supply chain attack
top_signals.summary: ConnectWise initially said on Friday that it was investigating “attempts of unauthorized access associated with the ConnectWise Cloud Backup environment,” and confirmed such access on Saturday.

top_signals.title: PJM, ERCOT, and SWPP all set peak load records this summer
top_signals.summary: Three regional transmission organizations (RTOs) set records for peak hourly load this past summer, according to data reported on Form EIA-930 and presented in the Hourly Electric Grid Monitor.
